eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 9:36 AM on AUG 17, 2022 Effective until 7:36 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Kingman Police Department.  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. Kingman Police Department is looking for Brenda Joyce Marshall, a seventy-one-year-old white female. Brenda's vehicle was last seen in the Phoenix area driving a white, two thousand and thirteen, Nissan, Juke with Arizona plate C P X 1 7 7 6. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
